programme.title: Lion T1 - Ep. 2
programme.desc: Against all odds, Kio survives a buffalo attack, but his troubles are far from over. At 12 weeks old, he is the youngest and most vulnerable member of the pride. To have any hope of one day becoming king, he must earn the respect of his older brothers and find his place among them. Just as he is finally able to gain their acceptance, the dry season sets in, and food becomes scarce.

programme.title: Lion T1 - Ep. 3
programme.desc: After a desperate search, Kio and Summer reunite with the brothers — but life on the fringes of the pride’s territory is unforgiving. As Summer struggles to hunt for her inexperienced sons and prepare them for independence, the demands of survival begin to take their toll. When an easy meal proves too tempting to resist. The consequences change Kio’s life forever, forcing him into independence far sooner than expected.

programme.title: Lion T1 - Ep. 4
programme.desc: Kio and his brothers have entered a dangerous new world. As the youngest, Kio is the most vulnerable. When he discovers a lush marshland rich with prey and a pride of lionesses, it seems they have found their new home. But this marshland already has kings. A brutal attack scatters the brotherhood and forces Kio to flee.

programme.title: Savage Kingdom: Clash Of Clans Compilations T2 - Ep. 1
programme.desc: Pula, the leopard ruler of the dark heart of the kingdom, faces a tough choice between her true love and her legacy. When Pula gives birth to Motshidi, it is her last chance at a dynasty. Blue Eyes, Motshidi’s father, cannot be trusted. He has been known to kill younglings. Pula must protect and train Motshidi to take her rightful place in the kingdom as Pula’s health weakens.

programme.title: The Incredible Pol Farm T1 - Ep. 1
programme.desc: The long-awaited spinoff of the legendary The Incredible Dr. Pol franchise has finally hatched! Spearheaded by Dr. Pol and his son Charles, the Pol familys three generations are all joining forces to grow their animal loving empire and take on an ambitious new project: transforming 350-acres of undeveloped land into a fully functional family farm!.

programme.title: The Incredible Pol Farm T1 - Ep. 2
programme.desc: After getting the tractor stuck in mud, Charles and Ben need a quick solution to plant hayseed in their field to provide food for their incoming animals. The Pol family must quickly figure out why their field is so wet even though it hasnt rained in days. Meanwhile, Dr. Pol helps Charles and Beth set up their first beehive colonies on the new farm.

programme.title: Elephant Planet - Ep. 1
programme.desc: Across Africa and Asia, four elephant families, following the wisdom of their matriarchal leaders, adapt on the move. Every step tests their instincts and intelligence, as they strive to carry on their legacy by ensuring the newborn’s survival. The Samas, a rare herd of desert elephants, endure brutal heat and relentless drought in a desperate search for water.

programme.title: Killer Safari T1 - Ep. 2
programme.desc: Hungry crocs battle a dangerous pod of hippos. The hippos take on a group of male lions. A honey badger battles for life against leopards, and wild dogs cause chaos everywhere they go! In the wilds of Southern Africa, the long, dry winter brings a desperation to the animals who live here. Prepare yourself for a highly charged, emotional and informative ride.

programme.title: Killer Safari T1 - Ep. 3
programme.desc: When the savannah turns into a battleground, it’s hard to choose a hero. We’re on the edge of our safari seats as a leopard is cornered by a pride of lions, a young impala is hurled into the air by a hippo and two hyenas try to drown each other. Then, the rarest of sightings as an Aardvark runs for its life from a brown hyaena. Who will win when it’s tooth versus claw?.

programme.title: Killer Safari T2 - Ep. 1
programme.desc: Life in the African bush is a game of survival, for both hunter and hunted. Add babies to the mix and you’ll see astounding feats of courage as mothers risk life and limb to protect their young. In spring, tall grass helps babies hide out of sight, but it also camouflages predators on the prowl. This game drive captures extraordinary behaviour as families and individuals battle to eat, defend, and raise young.

programme.title: Savage Kingdom: Clash Of Clans Compilations T2 - Ep. 1

programme.title: Mashatu: Land Of Leopards - Ep. 1
programme.desc: In Botswana’s Mashatu Game Reserve, one of the last sanctuaries for free-roaming leopards, a mother gives birth to two cubs. She’ll stop at nothing to protect them. But as climate change tightens its grip, resources dwindle, and a fierce leopard war looms.

programme.title: Killer Safari: Big Cat Battle Compilation T1 - Ep. 1
programme.desc: Tourists capture the best moments in the wild with their phones, and the big cats are at the top of everyone's safari wish list. Hold on as an elephant charges with a lion in its tusks. Watch male leopards in a turf war, and beware of one mother leopard’s hunting school. Cheetahs confront crocodiles to protect their meal. Large buffalo herds gather as a lone lion shows why he is king.

programme.title: Jade Eyed Leopard - Ep. 1
programme.desc: In Jade Eyed Leopard, big-cat filmmakers and National Geographic Explorers Beverly and Dereck Joubert follow Toto, a leopard with unusually bright aquamarine eyes, as she learns fundamental survival skills. Narrated by Academy Award-winning actor Jeremy Irons, this special films Toto during the first three years of her life as she experiences the challenges and triumphs on her way to becoming an adult.

programme.title: The Incredible Dr. Pol T24 - Ep. 4
programme.desc: Its Mothers Day! Dr. Pol and Dr. Brenda rush to the aid of animals struggling to give birth, while Dr. Lisa treats a cow suffering from a postpartum emergency. Two puppies get poked for their vaccines, and two older dogs come in with quills stuck all over their bodies. As Mothers Day approaches, Doc and Charles cook up a special treat for Diane and Beth. .

programme.title: The Incredible Dr. Pol T24 - Ep. 5
programme.desc: Get a documentary-style look into the personal lives of our country vets. Its a hectic schedule as Dr. Pol And Dr. Lisa see two dogs at once needing emergency labor. Dr. Brenda tangles with llamas. Baskets of puppies and frisky horses pay a visit to the clinic. See the vets wrangle their own kids, decompress on the lake, and care for their beloved animals. .

programme.title: Penguin Planet - Ep. 1
programme.desc: The Antarctic is the coldest, most unforgiving continent on the planet. It is a place where only the toughest creatures can survive. Enter the penguin: an ice-bound warrior synonymous with life in the freezer and purpose-built to thrive on the very edge of endurance. Then there's the wildcard. The African penguin has picked hot, sandy beaches to make its home, facing the opposite extreme.

programme.title: Big Little Giants - Ep. 1
programme.desc: Set in Botswana’s vast and untamed wilderness, “Big Little Giants” follows Africa’s youngest animals as they take their first steps into a challenging world shaped by drought, predators and ancient migration routes. From a newborn elephant learning to keep pace with its herd to jackal pups testing their instincts and cheetah cubs preparing for life at astonishing speed, each story unfolds through intimate moments of learning and loss.
